title: Version 18.5.2
body_markdown:
Released on **April 28, 2026**.

| Top bug fixes | From the community |
| --- | --- |
| [After upgrading to 18.5] Keyboard input may stop responding after using Find in Files | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/The-keyboard-stops-working-after-a-while/11076320) |
| Latest install of VS 2026 Insiders (11709.129) is removing 14.50 build tools | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Latest-install-of-VS-2026-Insiders-1170/11074955) |
| Claude Opus 4.7 stopped working after the last update | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Claude-Opus-47-stopped-working-after-th/11078994) |
| [C++] Bad codegen for switch(\*optional) in 64 bit in Visual Studio 2026 | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/C-Bad-codegen-for-switchoptional-/11003107) |

| Security advisories addressed | CVE | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ASP.NET Core Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability | [CVE-2026-40372](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-40372) | Improper verification of cryptographic signature in ASP.NET Core allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network. |
